extracted.name: Lauren's Chocolate Chip Cookies 🍪
extracted.description: Took me years to perfect this cookie.. The BEST Chocolate Chip Cookies of your life! Soft and chewy and bursting with chocolate goodness, this easy chocolate chip cookie recipe is life changing.
ingredient_lines: 3/4 cup unsalted butter, melted then cooled slightly
instruction_lines: In large bowl sift dry ingredients together.
Add the melted butter, brown sugar and granulated sugar with the dry ingredients.
Whisk in the vanilla extract, egg and egg yolk until the mixture is light and creamy. (DO NOT OVER MIX!)

Scoop out cookie dough, about 1/4 cup per cookie, and roll the dough balls in your hands until smooth. Now I freeze mine in a stainless steel bowl and you can always pre scoop and freeze on baking sheet and freeze for 30 minutes.
Place cookie dough about 3 inches apart on a parchment lined baking sheet or a baking sheet with a silicone baking mat.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes in the preheated oven. The cookies are done when the edges are golden and the center looks slightly under baked. (( DO NOT OVER BAKE!!))
Let the cookies cool on wire rack for at least 5 minutes and then transfer to a wire racks to finish cooling.
